# costfluent_team (Resource)

Manages a Costfluent team: a group of the organization's members that workspace access is granted to with costfluent_team_workspace_access. Its members are costfluent_team_member resources. Needs an organization token with `createTeam`, `viewMembers`, `manageTeam` and `deleteTeam`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A team its members are added to in the console; costfluent_team_workspace_access grants it workspaces
resource "costfluent_team" "platform" {
  name = "Platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name, unique in the organization.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Team ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import costfluent_team.platform team_0000000000000000000001
```
